title: Lesson 17 - Data Transform Types: Batch vs Streaming and When Each Applies
description: Explain data transformation capabilities within Data 360., focused on the two transform types, batch and streaming, and the latency and complexity trade-offs that decide which one a scenario needs.

questions.question: A team ingests clickstream events continuously and must trigger a real-time activation within seconds of an event. Which transformation capability fits?
options: A batch data transform scheduled every 15 minutes
A streaming data transform that reads the events and writes the prepared output
A data stream rerun with full refresh every hour
questions.explanation: Streaming transforms process records as they arrive and are active immediately, delivering near-real-time preparation. The strongest distractor, a 15 minute batch transform, still adds up to 15 minutes of latency and cannot meet a requirement measured in seconds.

questions.question: Which task is the best fit for a batch data transform rather than a streaming data transform?
options: Joining three objects, aggregating, and preparing an object for identity resolution on a nightly cadence
Reacting to a single event the moment it is ingested
Writing output within seconds of an abandoned cart
questions.explanation: A batch transform is a repeatable series of operations run manually or on a schedule and is built for heavy joins and aggregation. The strongest distractor, reacting the moment an event is ingested, describes exactly the latency profile that batch cannot provide.

questions.question: Which statement about streaming data transforms is TRUE?
options: They can be edited at any time after saving
They activate immediately when saved and cannot be modified, only deleted and recreated
Their source and target objects must be the same object
They can only write to data lake objects
questions.explanation: Help documents that streaming transforms activate on save and cannot be changed afterward. The distractor that says source and target must be the same object is the opposite of the rule, which requires them to be different objects.
